name: chatgpt-web-bridge
description: A protocol-driven local agent orchestration runtime for visible web AI planning, Codex App Server execution, and extensible brain/executor adapters.

interface.shortDescription: Let a selected web brain plan while Codex executes.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT Web Bridge uses ChatGPT Web by default and lets the user choose DeepSeek Web as an alternative visible planning brain. The Codex executor defaults to ChatGPT Luna, can use DeepSeek API Pro or Flash profiles, and can inherit the user's current local Codex configuration when that configuration already uses DeepSeek. It launches or connects to a dedicated browser session, relays rendered prompts and replies, supports brain-hand planning and evidence-first review, and binds Codex App Server worker threads to Control Plane routes. It does not read passwords, API keys, or call private web endpoints.
defaultPrompt: Run one bounded brain-to-Codex round for this task.
Send the executor's report to the selected web planning brain.

Use ChatGPT Web by default, or choose DeepSeek Web with brain_provider: deepseek; choose executor_provider: deepseek_api for a named DeepSeek profile, or codex_current to inherit a user's existing Codex/DeepSeek configuration.
